findings.title: harden-json-patch-values change is not implemented: non-JSON values still accepted
findings.why: openspec/changes/harden-json-patch-values says add, replace and test must reject a value that is undefined, NaN, Infinity, a function, a bigint, a symbol, or a Date or Map, at any depth. requireValue only checks that the 'value' member exists, and there is no isJsonValue helper. applyPatch(doc, [{op:'add', path:'/a', value:new Date()}]) or a value containing NaN is accepted and copied into the result. The change's tasks.md has every item unchecked, and test/patch.test.ts has no 'Value is not JSON' test. The change is committed alongside the code but does nothing.

findings.title: anchorsBeforeFrom and anchorsBeforeTo rebuild arrays on every call
findings.why: Each call spreads the anchor map and filters it, once per array item. That makes the gap matching in diffArrays quadratic on top of the LCS table. Computing prefix counts once would be simpler and cheaper.
